title: Body Language
tagline: Context-aware NPC body descriptions powered by OBody NG, RSV, and TNG.
description:
# Body Language 🎭

✨ A Skyrim SKSE plugin that integrates with SkyrimNet to generate rich, context-aware body descriptions for every NPC. It reads live body data from OBody NG, enriches it with muscularity hints and skin complexion details from Racial Skin Variance, and adds height and T.N.G (The New Gentleman) details — all surfaced to SkyrimNet's prompt templates automatically.

> 💡 **Zero Setup Required:** Every body replacer, custom follower body, runtime body morph, dynamic pregnancy/muscle morph, and skin texture overhaul works out of the box—whether loose files or packed inside BSAs.

## Requirements 📋

- SkyrimNet *(v0.25.0 or later)*
- Racial Skin Variance - SPID (RSV) & BnP - RSV Patch *(optional — normal-map muscularity and SPID skin complexion features are detected automatically)*
- The New Gentleman (TNG) or **Schlongs of Skyrim (SOS)** *(optional — adds unclothed size and addon anatomy descriptions natively via C++)*

## Key Features ✨

- 📐 **Universal 3D Mesh & Morph Analysis** — Slices any humanoid `_0.nif` and `_1.nif` into **10 anatomical cross-section rings (80 landmark vertices)** and reconstructs each actor's live body shape at runtime from their weight, active `SKEE` `.tri` morph sliders, and XPMSE bone scales.
- 👗 **Body-Replacer Agnostic** — Works seamlessly with **CBBE 3BA**, **BHUNP**, **UNP**, **TBD**, **UBE**, **HIMBO**, **SAM**, **COtR**, custom standalone follower bodies, and vanilla meshes.
- 🤰 **Pregnancy vs. Systemic Build Isolation** — Distinguishes localized anterior belly distension (pregnancy morphs or `NPC Belly` node scaling) from systemic body mass so pregnant slender or athletic NPCs are accurately described as pregnant rather than overweight.
- 💪 **On-Demand Normal Map Muscularity (`_msn.dds`)** — Streams each NPC's active object-space normal map from the VFS, decodes the $256 \times 256$ mipmap via `DirectXTex`, and runs a 2D Laplacian filter over the abdomen and deltoid UV regions to measure muscle definition.
- 🎨 **RSV Skin Complexion Features** — Detects Racial Skin Variance SPID keywords (`RSVnord`, `RSVbreton`, `RSVimperial`, `RSVredguard`, `RSVhighelf`, `RSVdarkelf`, `RSVwoodelf`, `RSVorc`, `RSVfantasymer`, `RSVvampirebeast`, `RSVdremora`, `RSVasian`) and injects clothed or naked complexion details (frostnip, freckles, scars, veins, tanlines, fantasy patterns, etc.).
- 🎯 **Context-Aware Prose** — Generates distinct descriptions for **clothed** vs. **naked** states and **full** (character bio / dialogue target) vs. **short** (inline reference) render modes.
- 📏 **Height Tiers** — Maps each actor's effective height multiplier to configurable height descriptors (`towering`, `tall`, `above_average`, `average`, `short`, `diminutive`).
- 🔞 **Native C++ TNG & SOS Integration** — Inspects equipped Slot 52 addons, XPMSE `NPC GenitalsBase [GenBase]` bone scales, TNG keywords, and SOS factions directly in C++ (no `.esp` or `StorageUtil` scripts needed).tomy descriptor is appended to the prompt. Racial size multipliers are applied automatically.

## Documentation 📖

- **User & Modder Customization Guide (`USER_CUSTOMIZATION.md`)** — Complete step-by-step guide to tuning ratio thresholds, editing body part phrases, calibrating normal maps, and adding custom TNG addons.
- **Architecture & Lifecycle Documentation (`ARCHITECTURE.md`)** — Technical deep-dive into the 10-ring 80-vertex slicer, `.tri` morph evaluation, Laplacian normal-map filter, and thread-safe caching pipeline.
- **Changelog (`CHANGELOG.md`)** — Full version history and release notes.

## Customization & Tuning 🛠️

`BodyLanguage` is 100% data-driven. All anthropometric ratio cutoffs, descriptive text snippets, normal-map roughness baselines, skin features, height ranges, and TNG addon descriptions live in plain-text JSON/INI files under `Data/SKSE/Plugins/`

### Inspecting Actor Measurements in `BodyLanguage.log`
Whenever SkyrimNet requests a description for an NPC, `BodyLanguage` logs their exact real-world measurements (`cm` / `inches`), dimensionless ratios, normal-map roughness score, and resulting tier classifications to `Documents\My Games\Skyrim Special Edition\SKSE\BodyLanguage.log`

changelog:
## v2.0.0
### Real-Time 3D Geometry & Normal-Map Engine
Complete rewrite replacing static BodySlide XML preset tables, `.7z` texture archive hashing, and Papyrus scripts with a **real-time, mod-agnostic 3D geometry and normal-map analysis engine** built natively in C++.
> **Upgrading from v1.x:** `TT_BodyLanguage.esp` has been removed (the mod is now ESP-free). When loading an existing save, Skyrim will warn that `TT_BodyLanguage.esp` is missing—this is expected and completely safe to continue past.
### Added
- **Universal 3D Body Mesh & Morph Analysis:** Directly reads `_0.nif`, `_1.nif`, and `.tri` files from Skyrim's VFS/BSAs, slicing any humanoid body replacer (3BA, BHUNP, UNP, UBE, HIMBO, SAM, vanilla, or custom follower bodies) into 10 anatomical rings (80 landmark vertices) and evaluating actor weight, RaceMenu (`skee64`) morphs, and XPMSE bone scales in real time.
- **Pregnancy vs. Weight Isolation:** Separates localized belly morphs and `NPC Belly` node scaling from overall body mass so pregnant slender/athletic NPCs are not misclassified as overweight.
- **On-Demand Normal Map Muscularity (`_msn.dds`):** Evaluates abdominal and deltoid normal-map definition at runtime via `DirectXTex` (configurable in `BodyLanguage.ini`) with zero startup archive scanning.
- **Native C++ TNG & SOS Support (`ttlb_get_genitals`):** Detects *The New Gentleman* (TNG) and *Schlongs of Skyrim* (SOS) sizes and addons natively in C++ while keeping all prose and thresholds user-editable in `0020_genitals.prompt`, `tngAddons.json`, and `geometryThresholds.json`.
- **SPID Keyword RSV Skin Complexions:** Instant keyword-based Racial Skin Variance (RSV) skin feature descriptions via `0005_skin_features.prompt` and `skinFeatures.json`.
- **Modular Prompts & Full JSON Customization:** Split `0401_appearance_body_shape.prompt` into modular `body_language` subcomponents (`0001_body`, `0005_skin_features`, `0010_height`, `0020_genitals`) backed by `geometryThresholds.json`, `FemaleParts.jso
